method: Actual browser discovery, filtering, and a small original-game history flow. This is not a complete catalog gameplay test.
checks: Genre IDs and human-readable labels find the actual matching catalog, including 2048 and Block Blast for puzzle and RPG/strategy aliases
Multiword queries intersect genre and source terms; selected genres stay scoped and apps/misc receive no fabricated genre matches
Saved and Recent searches stay inside their browser-local library while finding a racing title whose name does not contain racing
Keyboard-activated Arcade/Racing/Puzzle shortcuts select real genres; Mario remains a text search, preserving sort/availability and reloadable URLs
Punctuation and empty results remain honest; the original game launches and Back/Forward preserve genre, query, and the complete 3,099-entry inventory
